name: LangSmith
summary: LangSmith is LangChain's commercial platform for tracing, evaluating and monitoring LLM applications and agents. It records runs and threads, supports datasets, online and offline evaluations, annotation queues, dashboards and alerts, and works with LangChain/LangGraph as well as other frameworks and providers. It is offered as a cloud service, with hybrid and self-hosted options on the Enterprise plan.
facts: Free Developer seat with 5k base traces/mo; Plus $39/seat/mo
goodFor: Teams building on LangChain or LangGraph
Evals and annotation queues next to traces
